prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Swipe through to see how your pet hangs out, helps you focus, and reacts on your screen."]
1: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are generating your pet's animations and custom traits. You can safely minimize this window."]
2: ["Pick Your Companion Archetype"]
3: ["Ready to Launch Your Desktop Pet", "Learn how your pet lives on your screen and where to find your system tray controls."]
4: ["Signing in links your adopted pet safely to your account so you never lose your companion.", "Sign in to save your pet progress and sync seamlessly across devices."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Verified Companion Adoption"]
6: ["Quick Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open quick actions or put them to sleep."]
7: ["For best custom pet results, choose a clear, well-lit photo or tap to pick instant pre-made styles.", "Upload your photo to generate your unique desktop friend."]
8: ["Select Your Adoption Journey"]
9: ["Summon Pet to Desktop Now", "If your pet doesn't appear immediately on screen, check your system tray in the taskbar."]
